newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech prelim Aug real ind output up 5.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech prelim Aug real ind output up 5.0 pct.

text.p: Czech preliminary real industrial output in August rose 5.0 percent, year-on-year, putting output 8.6 percent higher for the January-August period, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT AUG 96 JULY 96 AUG 95 JAN-AUG 96
AVERAGE INDUST WAGES AUG 96 JULY 96 AUG 95 JAN-AUG 96
Note. Final August output/wage results are scheduled to be released on October 10. Wage results are taken from a survey of 210 firms with 100 or more employees.
Production results also contain estimates from firms with up to 100 workers, as well as physical persons registered in the trades offices.
